reuse.why: The new action reuses category selection, amount sign conversion, batching and undo wrappers, but fixed-tag detection bypasses the existing shared tag helpers.

duplication.why: Bulk eligibility remains centralized, but FIXED_TAG introduces another implementation of note-tag recognition.

placement.why: Budget selection and action registration follow existing module boundaries, although tag recognition belongs with the shared tag utilities.

scope.why: The change additionally modifies template execution eligibility and selects an unused goal_def field in getBudgetData.

maintainability.why: The centralized selector is straightforward to maintain, but independent tag semantics and the additional template-engine policy broaden ownership unnecessarily.

bypasses_abstraction.where: actions.ts: hasFixedTag uses FIXED_TAG instead of shared/tags.ts extractTagsFromText or makeTagAqlRegex.

disguised_duplication.where: actions.ts reshapes existing shared note-tag recognition into a dedicated FIXED_TAG regex with its own boundary and case rules.

abstraction_drift.where: getBulkBudgetCategories adds saved-template and fixed-group exclusion branches and replaces the existing includeHidden parameter; hasFixedTag independently implements recognition already provided by shared/tags.ts.
